description: Bytes read from an open File through read_to_end / read_to_string are a source: the buffer argument carries them to a command name, through a typed File formal and through a File::open local.

expected.notes: read_to_end on a File formal fills data, returned to the caller
read_to_string on a File::open local fills text
the buffer was a fresh Vec; the read overwrites what that allocation implied
